restaurantName: The Knightsbridge Lounge at the Park Tower Knightsbridge Hotel
bio: Nestled in the heart of Knightsbridge, the Lounge is a cosy, yet sophisticated Afternoon Tea Lounge that transports you to a world of luxurious indulgence. Offering a tantalizing array of dainty delights, it is the perfect spot to relish a delightful Afternoon Tea.  The Park Tower have crafted a menu of delectable delights, from finger sandwiches to tea cakes and freshly baked scones, served alongside their sbeautiful cakes such as the Serpentine Swan, a choux pastry swan filled with camomile vanilla Chantilly cream or the Orange Tart, a buttery, flaky pastry tart filled with homemade orange marmalade, whipped cream and fresh mint and finished with a crisp caramel tulip.  Situated in the heart of the hotel, the idyllic tea parlour boasts an impressive 18-foot teardrop glass chandelier and a stunning canopy of magnolia blossoms. The circular room is decorated with a mesmerizing trompe l’oeil wall motif and hand embroidered magnolia flowers. Elegant marble-topped tables surrounded by deep comfortable chairs create a serene atmosphere, perfect for lingering over their flavoursome Afternoon Tea.  With their proximity to Knightsbridge and Harrods, as well as the world-renowned Royal palaces, the lounge offers both convenience and charm. Whether you're taking a break from shopping or sightseeing, indulge in a delectable selection of treats.  This quintessentially British experience with impeccable royal connections is not to be missed.
pageTitle: The Knightsbridge Lounge at the Park Tower Knightsbridge Hotel
